item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(name, request, policy, expected):\\n before_r=copy.deepcopy(request); before_p=copy.deepcopy(policy); got=evaluate(request,policy); assert got==expected,(name,got,expected); assert request==before_r and policy==before_p,(name,'mutated'); print(name,json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))\\np={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncheck('priority_all',{'rows':[{'id':0,'amount':False,'unit':[]},{'id':'a','amount':False,'unit':[]},{'id':'b','amount':1,'unit':[]},{'id':'b','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':3,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\ncheck('defaults_conversion',{'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':0},{'id':'b','amount':2,'unit':'cm'}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0,'unit':'m'},{'id':'b','amount':0.02,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]})\\ncheck('finite_edges',{'rows':[{'id':'n','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'i','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'h','amount':10**1000}]},{'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1},'unique':False},{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'}]})\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); actual=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,p) for r in requests]; assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}}]}"}
